title: Binance Options Will Launch Additional BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT Daily Options
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Options will launch additional BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT Daily Options on  2023-05-15  at  08:00 (UTC).    Please note:   BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT Daily Options are European-style options contracts. Binance will launch T+3 BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT Daily Options on  2023-05-15  at  08:00 (UTC) . Thereafter, T+3 BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT Daily Options will be listed every day at  08:00 (UTC) . Please note that there will be no new T+3 BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT Daily Options listing if it coincides with the expiration of a BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT Weekly, Monthly or Quarterly options contract that day. BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT Daily Options will have a trading lifetime of three days and expire at 08:00 (UTC).  Please refer to  Binance Options Contract Specifications  for more details.  Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. Thanks for your support!
